description: Use when working with the Vercel **hosting platform** — the `vercel`/`vc` CLI (deploy, dev, build, env, dns, domains, blob, edge-config, firewall, rolling-release, logs, link, pull, tokens, redeploy, rollback, promote, mcp, …), the official hosted **MCP server** (https://mcp.vercel.com — OAuth; tools like deploy_to_vercel, search_documentation, get_deployment_build_logs), and platform concepts (deployments, builds, domains & DNS, env vars, serverless/edge functions, Edge Config, Blob, cron jobs, webhooks, teams/projects). Comprehensive offline docs fetched from vercel.com. Invoke for any `vercel <command>`/flag lookup, MCP-server question, or deploy/env/domain/function task. For the **REST API / OpenAPI spec / @vercel/sdk** use the sibling skill `working-with-vercel-api`. NOT for the Vercel AI SDK (`ai` package — generateText/streamText/useChat): use working-with-vercel-ai-sdk. NOT for Next.js framework APIs.
